name: Knock Rummy
description: Knock Rummy is a fast-paced variant of the classic Rummy family. Unlike standard Rummy where players must wait for a 'Gin' or empty their hand, in Knock Rummy any player can end the round by 'knocking' after their discard, provided they believe their unmatched card points (deadwood) are lower than their opponents'. It is a game of risk-assessment and speed.

content.text: Knock Rummy is a fast-paced variant of the classic Rummy family. Unlike standard Rummy where players must wait for a 'Gin' or empty their hand, in Knock Rummy any player can end the round by 'knocking' after their discard, provided they believe their unmatched card points (deadwood) are lower than their opponents'. It is a game of risk-assessment and speed.
Developed in the early 20th century as a quicker alternative to the lengthy '500 Rummy' matches. It directly influenced the development of Gin Rummy.
2 players (10 cards each), 3-5 players (7 cards each).
Standard 52-card deck. Aces are low (1) or high (11) depending on house rules.
